description: Screening values reported in manuscript Version 9 (Section 5.2 and Figure 2; Figure 3 in Version 8) for 2035_EB future_id 5, used by figures/scripts/verify.py. Tiers of 21, 32 and 97 MW and their costs reproduce EECA (2022) RETA Southland Phase One Report, p. 74; the 150 MW tier and its cost are an illustrative screening assumption with undocumented derivation (see DATA_SOURCES.md).
